epic.interestingFact: Jam Boree gets a full redesign every year to mark the game's anniversary. To avoid needing a yearly asset update, this app uses one fixed, current design rather than modeling every past year's look as a separate variant.

common.name: Astropod
alternativeAcquisition: Purchased from the Market for 20,000 Coins as a dormant statue, then woken up by zapping in the required eggs within a time limit
notes: Currency production is also affected by Polarity: being placed near its positive-pole Wublin boosts production up to 25%, while its negative-pole Wublin reduces it up to 25%. Exact pairings aren't itemized here — only Whajje's are confirmed (positive: Dwumrohl, negative: Zynth). The Polarity Amplifier (unlocked by collecting more unique monsters on Wublin Island) extends positive-pole range and shrinks negative-pole range over time. Also, a Wublin only gets the full effect from another Wublin of equal or higher rarity — an Epic Wublin gets no benefit from a Common one, for instance.
specialMechanics: Wake it by zapping in every required egg listed under Egg Requirements below
Time limit: 10d from purchase — miss it and the inventory resets, progress is lost

common.name: Brump
